title: Canonical endpoint isomorphisms for the integral/E exchange square
statement: For the coefficients and comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients] and [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-comparisons], a Cartesian square of separated finite-type k-schemes with proper f, and a bounded constructible integral M whose actual E scalar extension is the specified bounded constructible object N, there are source and target isomorphisms between scalar extensions of the integral exchange endpoints and the E exchange endpoints at N. They make the two specified exchange arrows commute. Neither exchange is assumed invertible.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; integral localization and the specified exchange

proof.text: Properness is stable under base change, so f′ is proper. Apply the qcqs push comparison theorem at M and at g′-pullback of M. Reflect isomorphisms along the full bounded constructible inclusions. The pull comparisons are already isomorphisms, so source and target composite comparisons are isomorphisms.

Take asIso of the two specified comparison morphisms and apply the fully faithful inclusions to obtain endpoint isomorphisms in the full E derived category. The underlying hom equation is exactly the already proved coefficient/exchange equation.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousIntegral_exchange_square [IsProper f]
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : integralConstructible ℓ E X)
    (hM : ProEtale.boundedConstructible
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)
        ((integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj M.obj)) :
    let N : ProEtale.BoundedConstructible
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) :=
      ⟨(integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj M.obj, hM⟩
    ∃ (s : (integralScalarExtension ℓ E Y').obj
          (((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
            boundedConstructibleUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (g.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj M).obj) ≅
        ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
          boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj N).obj)
      (t : (integralScalarExtension ℓ E Y').obj
          (((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
            boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj M).obj) ≅
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
          boundedConstructibleLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj N).obj),
      s.hom ≫ ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.toCommSq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app N).hom =
        (integralScalarExtension ℓ E Y').map
          ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (sq.toCommSq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app M).hom ≫
            t.hom
